gate.rule: any invented-number or false-compliant in any pass fails; any cycle that failed on an error fails; a borrower with expected facts and none read (nothing-read) fails; other accuracy is reported, not gated

guardrail_notes.detail: The statement of operations, statement of cash flows and supplemental page print no prior-year comparative column; their second column is the one month ended October 31, 2026, which is not a comparative period and was not spread. Only the balance sheet comparative (December 31, 2025) is reported.
a note from the agent contained a typed figure and was removed
The pack prints no SaaS metrics (MRR, ARR, customers, net new ARR, net revenue retention); these lines are left out.
No stock-based compensation memo line is printed in the pack.
a note from the agent contained a typed figure and was removed
The Summary amounts have no printed column header; the section heading 'Summary' was used as the column header.
The row 'Total balances on deposit' fits no template line for a bank statement and was not reported.
The collateral account is pledged to secure a hosting lease letter of credit and is not available for withdrawal.

The document is a monthly MRR report, not a financial-statement pack, so only the SaaS metric lines are reported. Its metrics are point-in-time as of October 31, 2026 rather than a ten-month year-to-date period.
No prior-year comparative column is printed; the trailing six months table covers only months of the current year and was not used.
The MRR bridge rows (opening MRR, new customers, expansion, contraction, churn, closing MRR) fit no template line and were not reported.
No units phrase is printed; figures are shown in dollars.
the run reached its step cap before giving an answer

unshown_text.text: Note 1 on page 5 is a one-month capitalised software rollforward; it was not spread as it covers the month only and has no template line beyond the balance sheet figure.
The document is a bank statement for October 2026, not a set of financial statements, so only the two bank account total lines were reported.

The Schedule 1 calculation for Minimum Unrestricted Cash on page two includes cash held in the pledged collateral account within Unrestricted Cash; a reviewer may wish to confirm whether pledged collateral cash qualifies as unrestricted under the credit agreement.
The requirement for Revenue to Plan wraps across two lines in the summary table on page one.

Dataflake has about {{fact:78f6ae81-0bfe-4964-bff9-c570772de4ee}} months of cash at current burn, which limits its ability to absorb setbacks before it needs new funding. The low-severity runway covenant signal shows this has been shrinking quickly. The cash covenant signals show the same pressure on its balance sheet.

Unrestricted cash of {{fact:c6b23fca-d829-47de-afb9-2c23d0a23106}} is below the {{fact:dfe07fca-0fbc-40ee-b40b-3a228a34e2f2}} minimum, giving headroom of {{fact:4485e2b5-96b8-4ad6-ba54-6343194e8b1c}}. That means the level is past the threshold, not merely close to it, though the signal is rated medium. It is the balance-sheet side of the short runway.

Runway covenant headroom fell from {{fact:0ac55194-1dd2-43ef-8b72-a1df0510d927}} in August to {{fact:3caa60a2-0f31-4409-a26f-9fb416c6117f}} in September and {{fact:09bff13b-0bba-432a-8f89-e9c4a43c04b8}} in October. Runway of {{fact:88465eb6-1917-4cd2-b16b-08d16b705fd9}} months remains above the {{fact:629bd59a-680f-43d2-9cd0-1e4063fb047e}}-month floor, but at this pace the cushion is thin. This is the trend behind the high-severity runway signal.

Cash covenant headroom moved from {{fact:c62ed519-9cd5-4290-86ff-3a880e7c459e}} in August to {{fact:34304bd5-0c7c-4ff3-a214-d8e31aa6b48b}} in September, then to {{fact:4485e2b5-96b8-4ad6-ba54-6343194e8b1c}} in October. The steady decline crossed below the minimum. This shows the medium-severity cash signal reflects ongoing burn, not a one-month dip.
